verdict.rationale: The IRS's online services collect and hold sensitive user data, so a policy or control against using that data for AI training is a fair privacy-posture question. The evidence pack contains no such policy or opt-out control. The only data-handling note is the automatic deletion of ID.me selfie, video and biometric data, which is an adjacent retention practice, not an AI-training control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
